title: Test genetically mapped endometrial genes across paired lesion sites and uterine case-control studies
question: Which endometrial eQTL-linked endometriosis genes show consistent lesion-versus-uterus shifts within patients, and do their uterine case-control contrasts agree?
scope: Five genes from Rahmioglu et al. Table 1. Paired Hever and Hull human series. Separate case-control estimates in Finland, Rome, Mumbai and Melbourne, plus a design audit for the planned RNA-seq follow-up.
steps: Fix gene family, primary estimand, multiplicity correction and tissue contrasts before calculating results.
Verify source-declared donor pairing, target identifiers and platform annotation.
Report every anchor and independently recompute exact tests.
deliverables: Tested offline analysis and aggregate result tables.
Source-linked interpretation including tissue and cellular composition limitations.
acceptance: No inferred pairs or nearest-gene substitutions.
Calibrate both candidate directions and five tested anchors.
Report paired and between-patient comparisons separately.
